title: Elite
hook: How does Elite end? Joel's murder, Isadora's revenge, and the closing of Las Encinas in the Season 8 series finale, explained.

sections.heading: The murder that ends Las Encinas
sections.body: Season 8 returns to the structure that has defined Elite from the beginning, opening with a flash-forward to a death and then unwinding how it happened. The defining event of the final season is Joel's murder, the killing that drives the story toward the permanent closure of Las Encinas. Where earlier seasons used a death to reset the school year, this one uses it to end the institution entirely. Every thread the show has pulled across its run is steered toward that single event and the collapse it finally triggers for the elite academy.

sections.heading: Who kills Joel, and the revenge that follows
sections.body: The finale names the killer. Joel Castellano is murdered by Detective Luis Marin, the adult authority figure whose involvement with the students curdles into violence. The retaliation is swift and personal. Isadora, unwilling to let Joel's death stand, kills Luis with a poisoned syringe, answering one murder with another. The chain of a student killed by a detective and a detective killed in revenge is the bloody core of the season, closing out the cycle of violence that has surrounded the school's privileged circle since the very first body.

sections.heading: The cover-up and the people who break it
sections.body: For most of the season the establishment does what it has always done, burying the truth. All the murders and events tied to Las Encinas across the years, Marina's murder, Polo's death, Samuel's accidental killing, Ivan's accident, Raul's death and now Joel's murder, are hidden from the public. The people who refuse to let that hold are Omar and Nadia. With the help of Principal Virginia, they take everything they know to the press, choosing exposure over the comfortable silence the school has relied on to protect itself for so long.

sections.heading: Las Encinas closes for good
sections.body: The revelation lands as a death blow. Once Omar and Nadia hand the full record of crimes and deaths to the press, the accumulated history of Las Encinas can no longer be contained, and the school is forced to close forever. The institution that survived season after season of scandal by hiding its bodies finally cannot outrun the sum of them. Elite ends not with a new term beginning but with the doors shut permanently, the elite academy dismantled by the very truth it spent eight seasons paying to suppress.

final_image: With every buried crime finally handed to the press, the doors of Las Encinas close for good, the school that hid its dead now shut down by the weight of all of them.

lingering_questions.q: Who kills Joel in Elite Season 8?
lingering_questions.a: Detective Luis Marin murders Joel Castellano. In revenge, Isadora then kills Luis with a poisoned syringe, the pair of deaths forming the central tragedy of the final season.

lingering_questions.q: Why does Las Encinas close at the end?
lingering_questions.a: Omar and Nadia, helped by Principal Virginia, give the press all the information on the murders and deaths tied to the school across the years, which makes Las Encinas close forever.
